# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 and managed math ports** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia milestone m151 and ports more color math to managed C# for performance. It fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, ports SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions off native calls, speeds up HarfBuzzSharp buffer and tag parsing, and adds new WASM/Emscripten test coverage.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m151** — Bundles Chrome milestone m151 along with several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges, and drops a workaround for SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#3788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3788))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed** — Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI). ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **CPU raster regression restored** — Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression introduced upstream. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **More math ported to managed C#** — Moves SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply to managed integer math, removing per-call native round-trips. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **HarfBuzzSharp hot paths made allocation-free** — Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) pooled and allocation-free, removes per-call char[4] allocations in Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, reads SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans, and speeds up SKColor hex parsing with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **GRContextOptions cleanup** — Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Platform

- **WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 and exception-handling coverage** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11, builds emsdk 5.0.6 libs with the new exnref exception handling, and adds a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding, removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse, and adds WASM/Emscripten 5.0.6 static library support.
